page_title: DOR 1-1 HOF | Dortmund v Hoffenheim 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+5' Harm Osmers is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' 1 - 1 GOAL! Haris Tabakovic meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:1.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' One of the players from Hoffenheim times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
89' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) takes the corner which is cleared.
89' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
88' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
86' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' Yan Couto (Dortmund) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Yannik Luhrs.
84' Yan Couto (Dortmund) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
81' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) was too forceful with his tackle and Harm Osmers interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
80' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
79' Here comes a substitution. Paul Hennrich (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Andrej Kramaric.
79' Substitution. Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) on for Anton Stach.
76' Here is a change. Giovanni Reyna is going off and Nuri Sahin gives the last tactical orders to Kjell Watjen (Dortmund).
76' Substitution. Jamie Gittens did his best and is replaced by Julien Duranville (Dortmund).
76' The referee is firm and issues Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) a deserved yellow card.
76' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
73' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) for his blatant foul.
71' Christian Ilzer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) replacing Tom Bischof.
71' Substitution. Max Moerstedt makes his way off the pitch and Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) comes on as his replacement.
70' The attendance for today's match is 81365.
69' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregor Kobel intercepts the ball.
68' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the right side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann denies him.
67' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul. Dortmund win a free kick.
66' Neat passing move from Dortmund in order to create new attacking opportunities.
64' Hoffenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) is brought on as a substitute for Pascal Gross.
59' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

57' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.

56' A brilliant individual effort! Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
54' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) for Diadie Samassekou.
54' Diadie Samassekou (Hoffenheim) makes a strong challenge and Harm Osmers blows for a foul.

51' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
50' Great teamplay by Dortmund as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' 1 - 0 Goal! Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 1:0.
46' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' Nuri Sahin makes a half-time substitution. Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) comes on in place of Maximilian Beier.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
45+1' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
44' A pass by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
40' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
39' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Dortmund comes to nothing.
36' Hoffenheim are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player. The ball possession is 58:42.
35' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
33' The Dortmund players are stunned as referee Harm Osmers changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
31' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Dortmund as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
31' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is going to take the penalty!
30' Foul! Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Dortmund have been awarded a penalty kick!
28' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
28' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Hoffenheim win a corner.
26' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Pascal Gross (Dortmund).

22' What an opportunity! Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
21' That's a free kick to Dortmund.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
19' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
19' The resulting corner, taken by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), comes to nothing.
18' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

16' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.

15' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Harm Osmers with no other option than to blow for a foul.
13' Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Oliver Baumann, who smothers the ball.
11' Yan Couto (Dortmund) swings it in and Serhou Guirassy gets on the end of it, but Oliver Baumann shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
9' A player from Hoffenheim commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
8' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
7' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.

6' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) smashes the ball with a volley from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
6' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
6' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Hoffenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' The Dortmund players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has just begun.
Hoffenheim will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Harm Osmers.
